name: kick-up-trailer
description: Trailer pipeline for Project Kick-Up: real gameplay capture, HyperFrames title cards, Remotion master edit.

scripts.endcard: cd hyperframes && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render --quality looks -o ../public/endcard.mp4
scripts.edit: remotion render remotion/index.jsx Trailer out/trailer.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.trailer: npm run capture && npm run endcard && npm run edit
